items.title: The chip influencer: the AI compute bottleneck is no longer the compute die but advanced packaging, interconnect latency and the memory hierarchy
items.summary: While the market frets over whether the tech giants' hundreds of billions of dollars of AI capex can ever be earned back, hardware engineers at the industry's leading edge are focused on a more fundamental question: the economics of Moore's Law have already broken down, and the real bottleneck in the compute race was never the chip itself — it has shifted from designing faster chips to controlling the physical stack from wafer to rack
items.title_zh: “芯片网红”：AI算力瓶颈早已不是算力芯片，而是先进封装、互连延迟与存储层级
